adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to only raise when `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` is false (it no longer checks a “missing host list” setting). In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the test “raises an error with a missing host” removed `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = nil` and calls `get :comments` without stubbing a referer, so it will now fail due to `request.referer` being nil (same condition covered by the “raises an error with no referer” test) rather than exercising a distinct “no allowed hosts configured” path. Also, the new admin CRUD endpoints (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` create/update/destroy) and admin embedding controller are not meaningfully tested beyond inheritance checks, and there’s no controller spec covering the case “referer present but no matching EmbeddableHost record.” However, the claim that no spec covers host normalization is only partially true: `spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb` does test trimming http/https/paths.
